hints.title: Cartesian Branching Obstacle
hints.text: Iterating with nested loops requires hardcoding the count of loops to the string length. How can recursive branching systematically explore all character combinations for arbitrary input lengths?

hints.title: Telephone Keypad Mapping Invariant
hints.text: Map each digit to its respective letter choices. Building the path character by character at each depth ensures complete exploration without duplicates.

hints.title: Backtracking Branching Procedure
hints.text: Define a mapping for digits 2 through 9. Maintain a current combination path. If path length matches digits length, append to results. Otherwise, iterate over all letters mapped to digits[index], recurse with index + 1, and backtrack by popping.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: length of digits string (0 <= N <= 4)
complexity.notes: At most 4 letters per digit producing up to 4^N combinations each of length N.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Hardcoded loops cannot scale to varying input string lengths dynamically.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Linear recursion depth space matches the input digits length.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Handling empty input edge case and clean recursive tree backtracking.
